geopolitics_summary: Europe faces extreme heat eroding growth and straining winter gas reserves; US Russia sanctions bill advances; Ukraine energy infrastructure under sustained attack.

themes.headline: Germany's gas reserves at risk; Europe faces winter shortage threat
themes.why_it_matters: Low EU gas storage ahead of winter directly pressures TTF forward curve and winter Cal+1 spreads. Supply tightness increases fuel-switching risk into power, supporting baseload prices.

themes.headline: Europe's scorching summer erases growth; demand destruction signaled
themes.why_it_matters: Economic contraction in France and Netherlands suppresses industrial power demand (aluminium, chemicals). Reduces forward curve support, especially Cal+1 and beyond. Demand destruction offsets any supply concerns.

themes.headline: US Senate passes Russia sanctions bill; House review looms September
themes.why_it_matters: Tighter Russia sanctions risk further LNG supply disruptions and higher global LNG prices, raising European TTF via arbitrage. Indirect but material pressure on gas-fired power merit order.

themes.headline: Greece's aging grid blamed for catastrophic wildfire risk escalation
themes.why_it_matters: Grid failures during wildfires threaten thermal/renewable capacity outages in SE Europe. Could disrupt SEE exports; reduces interconnector reliability, tightening regional balancing. Raises spot risk and ancillary demand.

themes.headline: Ukraine targets Russian refineries; winter energy attacks expected
themes.why_it_matters: Russian refinery losses reduce EU crude-to-fuel supply indirectly; potential winter energy attacks on Ukraine infrastructure could spike LNG spot imports to EU if Ukrainian gas cut off, driving TTF volatility.

watchlist: EU gas storage fill rates (weekly); target vs. Oct target for winter adequacy.
France 2027 blackout drill logistics; signals state emergency preparedness & potential DSM/load-shedding policy.
US House vote on Russia sanctions bill (September); outcome affects LNG export risk & TTF arbitrage.
Hormuz reopening negotiations finalization; crude & condensate flow implications for global LNG cost.
